title: Crossed-Out Eyes
dateBasis: UTC, from the archived creation timestamp
method: Every work in the room was inspected directly from the published WebP at 640 px in room order and as one wall before writing. Numbers come from data/gallery.json or data/abstract.json. No model inference calls were made; the text was written by the assistant in the session.
scope: The owned subset: the 26 works the locked structure places in this room, in room order.
introduction: Box heads with their eyes struck through. In this room the eye is an X, a red cross, a plus sign, or a letter, and the box head of the first room comes back with its eyes cancelled. Twenty-six works, from December 1, 2021 to March 18, 2022, and then the collection piece, #0000, made in July.

The cross is drawn many ways. A red X over a ring. A plus sign in a white box. Two red bars. And in a handful of works the eyes spell the artist's name: an X in one box, a Y in the next, a Z in the third. The letters N, N, X, Y and Z appear as eyes, as a brow, and on #48 as the whole face.

Watch the mouth under the crossed eyes. It is almost always a grid of white block teeth in a box, and as the eyes get stranger the teeth stay the same. The room ends on the one work that puts every mark in the series into a single square.

chapters.title: The First Crosses
chapters.opening: December 1 to 6, 2021. Eight box heads, the first with green crosses in its eyes, the last with the artist's name written across the whole face.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #26
works.text: A box head inside a white box frame on green, with two ringed eyes crossed by green plus signs, a V of red and white for a nose, and bands of yellow and red filling the face. Two small boxes with spirals sit at the sides like ears. It is the first crossed eye in the series, from December 1, 2021, drawn not as a cancellation but as a plus sign laid over a target.
works.caption: A box head in a white frame on green, two ringed eyes crossed by green plus signs, a V nose.
works.reading: The eyes are white rings with yellow inside, and the green cross on each is drawn in two strokes. Red zigzag runs under each eye like a lower lid. The V nose points down to a mouth that is only a few marks. Recorded with 133 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #28
works.caption: A tilted box head on green in cyan, pink and yellow scribble, one eye a white X in a ring.
works.reading: The head leans to the right and is drawn in dense scribble with a black outline. The X eye at the left is white in a ring; the right eye is a small red box. The teeth are a small box of white bars at the lower right. Recorded with 161 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #39
works.text: A rounded box head on dark teal in cyan and red scribble, two red crosses in blue eye boxes, and a mouth of white triangle teeth.
works.caption: A rounded box head on dark teal in cyan and red scribble, red crosses in blue eye boxes.
works.reading: The crosses are red bars over white discs in blue boxes. The nose is a yellow bar. The teeth are white triangles pointing up in a red mouth. The head is outlined in white and the scribble inside is cyan, red and orange. Recorded with 241 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #40
works.text: A box head on white in magenta and yellow scribble, two orange crosses in white eye boxes, and white block teeth in a tilted box.
works.caption: A box head on white in magenta and yellow scribble, two orange crosses in white eye boxes, white block teeth.
works.reading: The crosses are orange plus signs over white discs. The nose is a column of scribble. The teeth are white blocks in a box that tilts down to the right. Ninety-three strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #42
works.text: A block head on blue stripes with two orange ringed eyes crossed in white, and a mouth open on two rows of white teeth, upper and lower.
works.caption: A block head on blue stripes, orange ringed eyes crossed in white, a mouth open on two rows of teeth.
works.reading: The eyes are orange rings with white crosses, set in boxes with white marks around them. The mouth is a wide open box with white teeth at the top and bottom and a dark gap between. The stripes behind are blue, green and pink. Recorded with 137 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #46
works.text: A horned owl mask on blue with a yellow zigzag crown, a white X in one eye and a dot in the other, and a grille of white teeth in a red box.
works.caption: A horned owl mask on blue, a yellow zigzag crown, a white X in one eye, white teeth in red.
works.reading: The horns are two white points at the top corners. The eyes are boxes with white rings, the left crossed. The teeth are white bars in a red box at the lower center. Yellow and white scribble fills the face. Recorded with 165 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #48
works.text: The artist's name as a face. The letters N and N sit at the top in white, X Y Z in a box below them, a plus sign in cyan beside them, and a cross in a ring at the right. Below, a row of white ovals for teeth and a second row of ovals under a yellow wave. On purple and blue with yellow bars. Nothing here is a nose or a cheek; the face is made entirely of the name and its marks.
works.caption: The letters N, N, X, Y and Z drawn as a face, with a plus sign and a crossed ring.
works.reading: The letters are drawn in white and cyan loops with red behind them, and the box around X Y Z is outlined in yellow and red. The crossed ring at the right is a white X in a blue oval. The teeth are a row of seven white ovals in a yellow box. Recorded with 205 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #50
works.text: A dark square with neon slashes of lime, red, pink and blue across it, a pink X in one eye and a heart in the other, and a brown drip running down the center of the face. The mouth is a pink bar at the bottom. Where the name was drawn as a face a few hours earlier, here the marks have been thrown at the square: the X is a slash, the slashes are the face, and the drip runs through all of it.
works.caption: Neon slashes of lime, red and pink on a dark square, a pink X eye, a brown drip.
works.reading: The slashes are thick strokes drawn fast, lime at the sides, red at the top, pink at the bottom. The X eye at the left is pink over a grey ring; the right eye is a heart in a ring. The drip is a dark brown stroke that starts at the brow and runs to the mouth. Recorded with 248 strokes and nearly 99,000 points.

chapters.title: Crosses and Plus Signs
chapters.opening: December 31 to February 8. Six heads over five weeks, with red crosses, plus signs and target eyes, and long fangs.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #51
works.text: A box head with coils at the sides like springs, two triangle eyes with red crosses, a big grid of white teeth, drawn on the last day of 2021.
works.caption: Coils like springs beside a box head, two triangle eyes with red crosses, a big grid of white teeth.
works.reading: The coils are black spirals drawn up and down both sides of the head. The eyes are triangles pointing down with red crosses inside. The teeth are a wide box of white blocks with black loops over them. Recorded with 151 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #52
works.text: A box head on grey with two pink boxes for eyes, each with a white plus sign, a row of big white block teeth in a red box, and a comb of yellow and black spikes along the top for a crown. Drawn on the morning of January 1, 2022, in ninety-four strokes. A month after the first green crosses, the plus sign has become the whole eye: a white cross in a pink box, nothing else.
works.caption: A box head on grey, white plus signs in pink boxes for eyes, big block teeth, a comb of spikes.
works.reading: The spikes are yellow and black lines standing up along the top edge like the teeth of a comb. The eyes are two pink rounded boxes with a white cross in each. The teeth are eight white blocks in a red box. A purple band runs down the nose. Recorded on January 1, 2022.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #57
works.text: A head on yellow and white with a sunflower for one eye, green petals around a target, and a red cross for the other, two boxes of white teeth side by side.
works.caption: A head on yellow and white, a sunflower target for one eye, a red cross for the other, two mouths.
works.reading: The sunflower eye at the left is a ring of green petals around a white target. The right eye is a red cross in a white disc with yellow spikes around it. The two boxes of teeth sit at the lower left and lower right. Lime line frames the head. Recorded with 108 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #60
works.caption: Red and black boxes on white, one eye with a red cross, a small mouth of white teeth.
works.reading: The head is a box of grey and black with a red frame, and the eye at the center is a white box with a red cross. The mouth is a small red box with white dashes. Thin yellow and blue lines wander over the whole square. A hand with five fingers rises at the upper left.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #67
works.text: A box head on dark brown with a red cross in one eye and a red X in the other, long white fangs in a dark mouth, and yellow wavy marks floating on the ground.
works.caption: On dark brown, a box head whose eyes hold a red cross and a red X, long white fangs below.
works.reading: The eyes are white boxes, the left with a red cross and the right with a red X. The fangs are long white triangles pointing down and up in a dark mouth. Spikes of blue line stand up from the top of the head. The yellow wavy marks sit at the upper left and lower right. Ninety-nine strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #70
works.text: A box head on orange in pink and blue line, a red cross in one eye and a red X in the other, a grille of white teeth in a red box, and a crest of yellow strokes.
works.caption: A box head on orange in pink line, one eye a red cross, the other a red X, white teeth.
works.reading: The crosses sit in white boxes under spiky lids. The teeth are white blocks in a red box at the lower center. The crest along the top is yellow and pink strokes. The face is painted in soft orange and yellow under the line. Seventy-nine strokes.

chapters.title: X, Y and Z
chapters.opening: February 9 to 20, 2022. The eyes become letters. Six heads in which an X, a Y and a Z sit where the eyes should be.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #76
works.text: A box head on lavender with three boxes in a row for eyes, and in them an X, a Y and a Z in red. Below, two boxes of white teeth side by side and a third box of teeth at the bottom. Horns of red line stand at the top corners. The name has moved from the brow to the eyes, one letter to a box, and the head has three eyes to hold it.
works.caption: A box head on lavender with three eye boxes in a row, holding an X, a Y and a Z.
works.reading: The letters are red over white discs in square frames with yellow and black edges. The teeth are white blocks in three red-framed boxes, two above and one below. The horns are short red strokes. Yellow and cyan scribble fills the face. Eighty-seven strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #78
works.text: A box head on teal with a white X in one eye and a red cross in the other, a crown of yellow spikes, and a long bar of white teeth in a red box.
works.caption: On teal, a box head crowned with yellow spikes, one eye a white X, the other a red cross.
works.reading: The X at the left is white in a dark box; the cross at the right is red over a white disc. The crown is a row of yellow and white spikes along the top. The teeth are white blocks in a long red box at the bottom. Green and black bars frame the sides. Recorded with 119 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #80
works.text: A round head on orange and purple with two star X eyes in boxes, a white nose, and a ring of white teeth around the chin like a collar.
works.caption: A round head on orange and purple, star X eyes in boxes, a ring of white teeth around the chin.
works.reading: The teeth run around the lower edge of the face as a row of white and blue blocks. The eyes are X marks drawn as stars with blue and red, in white boxes under yellow zigzag brows. The nose is a long white shape between them. Recorded with 145 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #91
works.text: A head on magenta with a yellow X in one eye and a blue target in the other, a yellow Y for a nose, a grin of white teeth and a second small mouth under the left eye.
works.caption: A head on magenta, a yellow X eye, a blue target eye, a yellow Y nose, a second small mouth.
works.reading: The Y is drawn in thick yellow strokes from the brow to the nose. The second mouth is a small row of teeth under the left eye. The main grin is white blocks in a red mouth. The head is painted in pink and lilac under black line. Recorded with 104 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #92
works.text: A box head on olive with three boxes for eyes in a row, X, Y and Z in red, a triangle for a nose like a house, a column of blue ovals, and a box of white teeth. Eleven days after the first three-eyed head, the letters are back in their boxes, and the head is built from blocks: a box for the eyes, a box for the nose, a box for the teeth.
works.caption: A box head on olive with X, Y and Z in three eye boxes, a house-shaped nose, white teeth.
works.reading: The three boxes are outlined in black with red letters over white discs. The nose is a black triangle with a white stripe. The blue ovals run down the center like buttons, and orange ovals below them. The teeth are white bars in a red-framed box at the lower left. Recorded with 127 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #96
works.text: A box head on orange with a yellow hat brim, two red X marks in white eye boxes, a bar of white teeth, standing on a post like a sign.
works.caption: A box head with a yellow hat brim and red X eyes stands on a post like a sign.
works.reading: The brim is a yellow bar across the top with the crown of the hat behind it. The X marks are red over white discs. The teeth are white blocks in a red box. The post is two lines running down from the chin to the bottom edge. Sixty-seven strokes.

chapters.title: Last Boxes and the Collection Piece
chapters.opening: February 27 to March 18, 2022, five last box heads, and then the collection piece, drawn in July, which gathers every mark in the series into one square.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #97
works.text: A box head on purple standing on two posts, with two eyes of red bars in boxes, a yellow crest, and a long bar of white teeth.
works.caption: A box head on purple standing on two posts, red bars in boxed eyes, a yellow crest, white teeth.
works.reading: The eyes are two white boxes each with a red horizontal bar and a smaller box inside. The teeth are white blocks in a long box with black between them. The posts are two columns of line below the chin. Recorded with 100 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #99
works.text: A box head on yellow with goggles, two white ovals joined by a bar, each with a red cross, and a wide grin of white teeth.
works.caption: A box head on yellow with goggles, two white ovals each holding a red cross, a wide grin.
works.reading: The goggles are two tall white ovals with red crosses, joined by a red bar across the bridge. The grin is a wide dark mouth with white blocks. A small ear loops at the left. Blue and green scribble fills the head. Recorded with 140 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #101
works.caption: A tilted box head on grey with two red X eyes in red, black and yellow scribble, teeth below.
works.reading: The head leans to the right and is drawn in dense scribble with a black outline. Both eyes are red X marks in white boxes. The teeth are white blocks in a dark mouth at the lower left. Recorded with 109 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #106
works.caption: A box head on olive, a red X in one eye, a red bar in the other, white teeth below.
works.reading: The eyes are two white boxes, the left with a red X and the right with a red bar. The teeth are white blocks in a dark box at the bottom. Green, purple and black scribble fills the face and the ground. Sixty-three strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #109
works.text: A box head on maroon with a red and white X in a cyan box for one eye and a slash in the other, orange horns, a long nose, and a grin of white teeth, the last of the crossed boxes, from March 18, 2022.
works.caption: A box head on maroon, a red X in a cyan box for one eye, orange horns, white teeth.
works.reading: The horns are two orange points at the top. The X at the left is red and white in a cyan box; the right eye is a blue ring with an orange slash. The teeth are white blocks in a dark mouth. Sixty-nine strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #0000
works.text: The collection piece, an edition of one, drawn on July 20, 2022, four months after the last numbered face. A dense square of pattern: the letters N, N, X, Y and Z drawn large in the center, a red heart at the top, a flower at the right, beads, zigzags, grids and teeth filling every corner. With 753 recorded strokes and 121,668 points it is the most worked drawing in the Faces. The name that was a face in December is here the whole picture.
works.caption: A dense square of pattern, the letters N, N, X, Y and Z drawn large, a red heart above.
works.reading: The letters are built from blocks and bars with scribble inside, and the Y in the center is a column of striped boxes. The heart at the top is red with a dark edge. The flower at the right has a small face in it. Rows of white teeth run along the bottom, and columns of colored beads frame the sides.

closing: Look again at the first crossed eyes, green plus signs on a box head in December, and then at the collection piece, where the letters of the name fill the square. The X started as a mark on an eye. By July it was the subject.
